description: Implementation of the ue class handling user equipment context in a 5G NR scheduler, including buffer management, reconfiguration, and slot indication.

classes.name: ue
classes.description: Represents a user equipment context in the scheduler, managing buffer states, reconfiguration, and slot indications.

methods.name: ue::ue
methods.description: Constructor initializing UE with configuration, channel repository, DRX controller, TA manager, and cell lookup.

methods.name: ue::slot_indication
methods.description: Handles slot indication events and updates DRX accordingly.

methods.name: ue::deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the UE, disabling logical channels and canceling HARQ retransmissions.

methods.name: ue::handle_reconfiguration_request
methods.description: Updates UE configuration based on reconfiguration requests.

methods.name: ue::handle_dl_buffer_state_indication
methods.description: Processes downlink buffer state indications, adjusting pending bytes considering HARQ retransmissions.

methods.name: ue::pending_ul_newtx_bytes
methods.description: Calculates pending uplink bytes for new transmissions, considering BSRs, HARQ allocations, and pending SRs.
